app_info.subtitle: Manage OmniChat inbox
app_info.description: OmniChat lets merchants manage omnichannel inbox and CRM from ChatGPT: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Webchat, email, leads, AI, integrations, automations, and team after OmniChat OAuth. Channel/shop API secrets are configured only in the OmniChat dashboard via connect URLs — not accepted in-chat.
